say:3:1120317001:1.text: Potion-crafting is a delicate art, that requires sophisticated and professional equipment in order to be performed properly.
say:3:1120317001:1.source_cn: 制药这种事，还是要到专业的地方，使用专业的设备才行。

say:4:1120317002:1.text: Naturally, my wonderful home is equipped with all of the necessary facilities!
say:4:1120317002:1.source_cn: 那当然就是在下家里的这些设备了。

say:5:1120317003:1.text: You're not talking about this rusty old cauldron, are you?
say:5:1120317003:1.source_cn: 你指的是面前的这口老旧的锅吗？

say:6:1120317004:1.text: Don't underestimate it! Every single scratch and stain is a testament to my achievements as an apothecary!
say:6:1120317004:1.source_cn: 不要小看它！这上面所有的痕迹，可都是成功药剂后留下的勋章啊。

say:7:1120317005:1.text: For a professional potion maker, your equipment doesn't seem especially professional. If anything, it all seems pretty crude...
say:7:1120317005:1.source_cn: 那你的专业制药设备，看起来有确实有些不专业，还很简陋。

say:8:1120317006:1.text: The word you're looking for is "minimalistic"! Besides, a cauldron doesn't need to do much more than serve as a container.
say:8:1120317006:1.source_cn: 哎呀，这怎么能叫简陋呢，只是比较简约罢了！而且锅这种东...

say:9:1120317007:1.text: I can't believe this guy just called his stuff "professional" a minute ago...
say:9:1120317007:1.source_cn: 这个家伙……明明刚刚还在说什么“专业的设备”……

say:10:1120317008:1.text: Alright, that's enough! This is the extract of all your hard-earned herbs, but that's not the end...
say:10:1120317008:1.source_cn: 安静安静，我要开始正式制药了。这些是你们刚刚好不容易摘...

say:12:1120317010:1.text: Don't just stand there! Come here and help me stir!
